snippet.title: SingStar Launch Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
http://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/singstar-digital-ps3/

Everyone’s got what it takes.
Get your hands on the ultimate competitive singing game by downloading SingStar™.

You don’t even need microphones to play – just download the SingStar™ Mic app to your compatible Android™ device, iPhone or iPod Touch and it will be turned into a personal mic!

For all your latest SingStar news go to:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SingStar
Twitter: http://twitter.com/SingStarHQ
Website: http://singstar.com
